title: 3 Do's and Don't's of Internship Cover Letters ✍️ #coverletter
description:
If you’re applying to an internship it’s likely you’re writing some of your first cover letters so to help you avoid some common mistakes here’s 3 do’s and don’t to follow.

DO addresses the letter to the hiring manager by name.

DO include relevant contact information.

DO detail why you are excited for the specific role you are applying to.
#coverletterexample #coverlettertips #jobsearchtips
